9.5 ARCHEOLOGY
An archeological survey has been made of the proposed site for the Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project which did not identify any archeological resources in this area. Since the survey did not include the proposed transmission line corridors, however, additional reconnaissance of these areas should be made prior to construction.
Reports of the archeological surveys to be conducted along the transmission line route should be filed with the Commission and with the State Historic Preservation Officer of South Carolina. If archeological sites are discovered, they should be evaluated for possible inclusion in the National Register of Historic Places, prior to the final location of project faciliites. All reasonable efforts should be made to avoid impacting significant sites, but where this is impossible, such sites should be salvaged after consultation with the State Historic Preservation Officer. Reports of any salvage operations should be forwarded to the FPC, the State of South Carolina Historic Preservation Officer, and to the Atlanta Regional Office of the U.S. Park Service's Interagency Archeological Services Division.
9.6 Scenic and Aesthetic Resources
The Applicant, in its initial application (filed February 4, 1974), indicated that transmission line towers would be erected by conventional methods where conditions permit. Applicant further indicated that in areas that are inaccessible to cranes and heavy equipment, helicopters may be utilized for setting towers. Amendment #2 to the application (filed March 29, 1976), made substantial changes in the entire application (which requires re-evaluation), and eliminated the reference to the use of helicopters where their use would substantially reduce environmental impacts. Another concern brought out in Amendment #2 is the added statement that "no tree trimming will be done." Eliminating the possible use of helicopters during construction and stating that trimming would not be used as a possible construction and maintenance technique is not in the best interest of environmental protection.
